nodes.title: Resolve P vs NP (e.g., prove NP not in P/poly or exhibit poly-time SAT)
Prune black-box Tseitin + sub-exponential 3-SAT route via Tseitin-ETH Scaling Dichotomy
nodes.summary: Proved & verified that black-box Tseitin with exp(m/sqrt(log m)) 3-SAT peaks at s*(n)=Theta(n*sqrt(log n)), and reaching P/poly requires 3-SAT in DTIME(2^(m^eps)) for all eps > 0.

nodes.title: Diagnose Williams-to-Hardness-Magnification bridge (Class Gap + Locality Barrier)
nodes.summary: Documented NEXP-vs-NP class gap and CHOPRS (STOC 2020) Locality Barrier blocking naive magnification gluing.

nodes.title: Eliminate sorrys in formal/lean4/MillenniumRelay/TseitinDichotomy.lean and enable Lean CI
nodes.summary: Formalize the Tseitin variable-count bound and the asymptotic P/poly scaling dichotomy in Lean 4 with zero sorrys.

nodes.title: Design structure-preserving TC0-SAT algorithm avoiding Tseitin variable blowup
nodes.summary: Target a 2^(n - n^delta) Circuit-SAT algorithm for depth-d TC0 circuits with n^(1+eps) wires via polynomial approximations or linear-threshold decompositions, aiming at NEXP not in TC0.

nodes.title: Explore non-local Hardness Magnification / Hirahara non-black-box reductions for MKtP
nodes.summary: Investigate meta-complexity reductions that bypass the CHOPRS (2020) small-depth oracle locality barrier.

nodes.title: Computational & formal testbed for GCT multiplicity obstructions (Kronecker / plethysm)
nodes.summary: Build reproducible multiplicity-obstruction verification scripts for small (n, m) permanent-vs-determinant instances to chart surviving GCT routes.
